name: Na kraju sveta
source:
A peaceful future. Dozens of planets and civilizations, living by their own rules.

The main character - an ordinary student, hurrying to home planet after the third year of study. University left behind, and two months vacation, full of idleness and pleasure are inevitable coming.

During the flight, Spaceliner stops briefly at the station "Omega" - the tourist metropolis hanging at the intersection of star trails. Having a walk "for half an hour", the main character gets into trouble and nearly dies of asphyxia. As a result of the accident, he is leaved on the station for medical treatment. His vacation go awry, but ... maybe it's for the better?

Restoring power and getting into funny situations, the main character meets new friends, the need to earn a return ticket, and the first serious relations. Will it break the walls, rules, hearts and return home? The accident, after all, was only the beginning of a chain of mysterious events ...
translation:
宁静的未来。数十颗星球与数十种文明，各自遵循着自己的规则生活。

主角是一名普通大学生，结束大三学业后，正赶往故乡所在的星球。大学已暂时抛在身后，整整两个月悠闲惬意的假期即将到来。

航行途中，星际客轮在“欧米伽”空间站短暂停靠。这座旅游都市悬于星际航路的交汇处。主角本打算出去逛“半小时”，却惹上麻烦，差点因窒息而丧命。事故发生后，他被留在空间站接受治疗。假期就这样泡了汤，不过……也许这反而是件好事？

在恢复体力、经历种种趣事的过程中，主角结识了新朋友，必须设法赚取返程票的钱，也迎来了第一段认真的恋情。他能冲破阻碍、打破规则、赢得芳心，最终回到家乡吗？毕竟，那场事故只是接连发生的神秘事件的开端……
